correctness.rationale: Universal proof for all integers 2≤m<n: Babson–Kozlov wedge concentration in degree n−m is explicitly an input. Each polyhedral cell is a product of m nonempty disjoint color subsets. For a fixed (σ,π) action, the product-cell orientation determinant equals sign(π restricted to occupied colors)×sign(σ) by quotienting the color-permutation space by blockwise constants. On a target π cycle of length ℓ, a σ-block cycle of length a can be used equivariantly iff a divides ℓ, with exactly a phases; summing occupied cycles with sign and inclusion–exclusion over all σ cycles gives L(σ,π). The Hopf trace removes H0 trace one, producing χ_top=(−1)^(n−m)(L−1). Independent exact enumeration of all cells and signed fixed-cell traces for all 12 joint actions for (2,3) and all 144 for (3,4) matches the closed formula; these finite tests are not the all-m,n proof. The ordinary and sign-weighted symmetric cycle-index evaluations give S_n-invariant rank0 and A_n-invariant rank binom(n−2,m−2). The connectedness and rational-coefficient and ordinary orbit-space boundaries are explicit; no integral-lattice or homotopy-orbit result.
